<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex67022026-01-1608-36-33" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Post-colophon annotation (lineage)"/>
				<lb edRef="inst:4711" n="122a8"/> chos 'di'i rgyud pa ni 
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3743">slob dpon chen po shan ta de ba</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5534">dul ba'i lha</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3802">su na ya shri'mi tra</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8320">bram ze nag po chen?</rs> | 
				<rs type="person">kha ba * na shri</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba chen po blo ldan shes rab</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294">khyung po grags se</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya dmar</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">gtsang <lb edRef="inst:5152" n="73a7"/> nag</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4315">mkhas pa mtshur</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4256">gtsang pa rdo rje seng ge</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4257">skyi seng ge rgyal mtshan</rs> |
				<lb edRef="inst:4711" n="122a9"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4258">tshul khrims seng ge</rs> |
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4069">rin chen rgyal mtshan</rs> |
				de la <rs type="person">smon lam tshul khrims</rs> dang ** bzang po bden gis * so ||
				bstan pa dang * la phan ** gyur cig ||</seg></TEI>
